control_failures.control_label: integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: near hit during cleaning and preparation on ZV-7211

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on ZV-7211 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. ZV-7211 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 21 December 2006 a near hit was recorded on ZV-7211 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during cleaning and preparation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
